Challenges of this module How do we represent an optimization problem? What are the “tricks” to represent decisions? What are the different types of constraints? How can we transform the the problem? How to deal with problems with multiple optimization criteria? What about no optimization criteria? …

# Page 4^page=4
One recommendation We are only modeling Refrain from thinking about solving the problem even if it is obvious

# Page 5^page=5
Modeling an optimization problem Decisions What are the decisions to be taken? How do you characterize your solution? Rules How decision are regulated? Objective What do you have to optimize?

Modeling an optimization problem Decisions Variables Rules Mathematical constraints equalities or inequalities Objective Function
